disclosures.text: A cutting unit for slicing food products
The cutting unit is a rotating cutting knife
The cutting unit is driven by a drive
A product feeder feeds food product to the cutting unit
A receiving unit receives cut food product slices
A control system stores at least one specification
The control system monitors at least one status parameter
The control system determines if a predefined condition is met based on status parameter and specification
The predefined condition requires a maintenance measure
A robot displaces food products
The robot has at least one robot arm
A gripping unit is located on the robot arm for picking up food product
The robot seizes food products from a surface
The robot displaces food products to a desired location
A control system stores at least one specification for a robot motion program
The control system monitors at least one status parameter for the robot
The predefined condition for the robot requires a maintenance measure
At least one camera captures information related to the cutting unit
At least one camera captures information related to the food product
At least one camera captures information related to the food product slices
At least one camera captures information related to the robot

A device for slicing a food product comprising a cutting unit, a product feeder, a receiving unit, and a control system storing specifications, monitoring status parameters, and determining if a maintenance condition is met

A device with a robot for displacing food products, having a robot arm with a gripping unit, a control system storing motion program specifications, monitoring status parameters, and determining if a maintenance condition is met
A device for slicing food products comprising a cutting unit, a product feeder, a receiving unit, and a camera capturing information about the cutting unit, food product, or slices
The control system stores specifications for a cutting program
The specification is selected from a plurality of cutting program specifications
The status parameter is the temperature of the drive
The drive is an electric motor
The status parameter is the motor current of the electric motor
A gripper with a gripper drive is provided
The gripper engages the food product during slicing
The status parameter is the motor current of the gripper drive
The status parameter is the cutting pressure of the cutting unit
The status parameter is vibration intensity and/or frequency at the device
The status parameter is oscillation intensity at the cutting knife's edge
The status parameter is food product temperature before slicing
The status parameter is sliced food product temperature after slicing
Cutting program specifications include cutting speed of the cutting unit
Cutting program specifications include the type of food product
Cutting program specifications include the feed rate of the food product
The control system applies specifications against status parameters to determine condition
The predefined condition is met when leaving a tolerance region for the status parameter
The tolerance region is determined by the cutting program specification
The cutting knife has a sensor for capturing the status parameter
The control system stores selected motion program specifications from a plurality
The robot arm has an electric drive
The status parameter is the supply current of the robot arm's electric drive
The status parameter is the temperature of the robot arm's electric drive
The status parameter is the position of the robot arm
The status parameter is the speed of the robot arm
The robot arm position/speed is captured by an incremental encoder
A camera captures a status parameter of the device
The camera and control system determine food product slice position as a status parameter
The camera and control system determine a center point of food product slices as a status parameter
The control system adjusts an operation parameter if the predefined condition is met
The control system outputs a warning signal if the predefined condition is met
The control system continuously monitors the status parameter
The control system monitors the status parameter at discrete sample points
The control system determines the condition by evaluating status parameters at different times
The control system considers at least one status parameter in condition calculation
A memory element stores the status parameters
The camera monitors the orientation of the food product
The camera monitors the structure or size of the food product slices
The camera monitors the wear of the cutting knife
The camera determines the form of the loaded cutting knife
The camera determines the position of the food product slices
The camera determines the center point of the food product slices
The camera determines the position of the gripping unit
A control system monitors a status parameter determined by camera information
The predefined condition requires a measure, especially maintenance
A memory element stores information detected by the camera
